title: Start here
summary: Learn the execution model, make one transaction, then choose the current TypeScript client and a maintained scaffold or course.

links.description: Use the first-party map for accounts, transactions, programs, RPC, validators, payments, and tools.
Complete a first transaction and program exercise in Solana Playground. Its burner wallet and browser environment are for development and testing only.
Generate an app from a maintained Solana Foundation template, then inspect the selected template's client dependencies.
Start new TypeScript applications with @solana/kit and identify where legacy web3.js compatibility is still required.
Follow an active structured course. Some exercises still use legacy-compatible packages, so compare setup and client choices with current docs.
